title: Pinned reader evidence, decode accounting, and the 3D support ceiling
mode: Read-only primary-source research and local plan crosswalk
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Pin and reconcile the spec-led dwg-rs reader snapshot, its decode accounting, and its test/semantic limits
Refresh the documented FreeCAD DWG-to-DXF consumer route
Cross-check DWG reader safety and 3D writer omission leads against existing local plan owners
Refine existing peer admission and composed validation gates without adding routine peer/native work

sources.revision: main at d0ce39be6a679697554db0ee1f84f0d0671bf081 (2026-09-07); no GitHub release
sources.observed: The project declares an ODA v5.4.1-based pre-alpha DWG reader. Its dated status reports 19 files with per-version decoded/skipped/errored outcomes, per-entity stream-boundary checks, handle-map closure and object-stream tiling for its own corpus. Its record parser recognizes ACIS entity envelopes, but its 3DSOLID geometry adapter is a bounding-box placeholder and the README disclaims external CAD acceptance. The same README contains conflicting coverage and test-count figures: its table says 88.0% aggregate and 92.2% AC1032, while nearby stale text says 95.6% aggregate and 90.3%/85.9%, and an old paragraph lists 649 tests versus 774 in STATUS.md.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Pinned, self-reported project documentation and corpus claims; useful for optional structural comparison and denominator design only. No peer behavior was executed or reproduced. Not a semantic ACIS/B-rep oracle, DXF parser/writer qualification, or native acceptance result.

sources.observed: Current docs describe DWG as an external-converter-to-DXF route followed by a selectable DXF importer; C++ and legacy Python importer coverage differs, and stock FreeCAD cannot read embedded ACIS solids.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Route and configuration declarations only; no native Linux/Windows FreeCAD qualification was run.

sources.observed: The release notes document R2004 decompression and section-map security fixes, including a decompressed logical-size versus live-allocation-capacity mismatch and unchecked page-map offsets.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer security fix history only; it does not establish a corresponding libdxfrw defect. Relevant hazards are already mapped to existing local safety owners.

sources.revision: Issue #1195 reviewed 2026-10-19; issue body identifies ACadSharp 3.4.9, but no source commit or drawing is public
sources.observed: The reporter claims that 3DSOLID/REGION parsed from two private DWGs were omitted during DWG-to-DXF output, leaving solid-only blocks empty; the issue proposes notifications or opaque carrier output as possible remedies.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Unreproduced issue report tied to an author-declared version and private inputs; not proof of a current peer defect or a libdxfrw failure.

localEvidence: Existing PAR-07/S8 separates record parsing, modeler carrier capture/linkage, DXF carrier output, strict reopen, semantic interpretation, and downstream/native acceptance.
Existing peer-admission rules already require immutable revision, exact input and corpus provenance, per-version/per-family dispositions, and explicit skipped/error denominators.
Existing local safety and boundary controls map the LibreDWG hazards to PAR-14, 7BE, 7S.3, and S3.7; no matching defect was confirmed in this research pass.
The current implementation's local generated tests and reduced validation cadence remain the ordinary per-slice path; peers/native applications stay at composed checkpoints.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing peer-admission and PAR-07/S8 evidence gates: pin the peer revision and corpus, report raw/typed/skipped/error/refused/not-attempted outcomes separately, include handle-map and record-stream closure where applicable, and keep 3D carrier and semantic/native stages distinct. No peer dependency, external sample, routine peer execution, new finding, or support claim is added.

method.kind: Read-only web/GitHub source inspection and local plan/source crosswalk
method.limitations: Peer reports are self-authored and corpus-bound; FreeCAD pages and LibreDWG master are mutable; ACadSharp #1195 has no public reproducer. No result establishes local behavior, normative format truth, or external semantic acceptance.
